Preschool and Early Elementary Message: Inviting Everyone

July 27, 2026
By ChildrensMinistry.com
XFacebookLinkedInEmailPinterestSMSThreads

Share

Facebook
Twitter
Pinterest
Email
    Listen to audio version of this article
    Sponsored by
    0:00 / 1:43
    Instaread

    You don’t have to be famous for Jesus to love you. Jesus’ love isn’t exclusive, but when we’re honest, ours often is. How can we help kids include everyone at church? This children’s message can help teach kids about inviting everyone.

    You’ll Need:
    • Bible (try this kid-friendly version!)
    • treat for each child (these can be simple toys, too, instead of food)

    Lead the Activity:

    Grow Your Outreach$64.95$29.99

    Select half the children to be “famous.” Tell them to talk only to one another. Let the groups interact for one minute.

    RELATED: 15 A+ Back-to-School Ideas for Children’s Ministry

    Say: Now we’ll have a party and invite only our famous friends. If you’re not famous, please sit in the corner of the room. Pass out treats to the famous group. Continue to role play until you sense kids’ frustration. Then gather everyone in a circle, and pass out treats to the rest of the kids.

    Ask:

    • If you were famous, how did it feel to ignore your friends in the other group?
    • If you weren’t famous, how did it feel to be ignored and not get invited?
    • Have you ever felt this way at church or at school? Explain.
    • What are some reasons we don’t include people?

    Read Luke 14:12-14.

    Say: Jesus said we should include and invite people no matter what they look like or what they own.

    Ask:

    • What are ways you can include and invite people at church or school?

    Close this message in a prayer asking God to help us make sure we’re including and inviting others.
